summary: LibreBooking is a self-hosted web-based resource/room booking scheduler (a Booked Scheduler fork): admins define schedules, resources, resource groups and types; users book time slots on resources as reservation series (with repeat rules, participants, invitees, guests, accessories, attachments and reminders); owners/admins create blackout periods and quotas; the system tracks custom attributes, credits/payments, email reminders and saved reports. State is persisted in a MySQL relational schema (users, resources, schedules, reservation_series/instances, groups, custom_attributes, payment/credit logs) and read back through repository and webservice layers.
